Move a project from renv

Source: R/pixi_import.R
pixi_import_renv.Rd

Add the packages in a project's renv.lock to its Pixi project, install them, and turn renv off.

  • Packages from CRAN, or another CRAN-like repository, are looked up on conda-forge, and Bioconductor packages on bioconda. CRAN packages that aren't on conda-forge can be built from CRAN's source instead (experimental): pixi_import_renv() offers to, or if it can't ask, lists them with the command that does. Other packages that aren't on conda-forge or bioconda are left out, and listed.

  • Packages from GitHub (experimental) are built from source at the commit renv.lock records, as pixi_add("github::user/repo@commit") does. With versions = "none", they're built from the newest commit of the branch it records. Packages in a subfolder of a repository, and packages from elsewhere, are left out, and listed.

  • By default only the packages that no other package in the lock file needs are added, so pixi.toml lists what the project uses, rather than everything those packages need too. Packages from GitHub are added either way, as conda-forge doesn't have them.

  • The lock file's version of R becomes a constraint on R, if the project doesn't have R yet. If conda-forge doesn't have the packages for that R, e.g. a new R it hasn't built packages for yet, it says so and uses the newest R that has them.

It says which packages Pixi builds from source, as building them is experimental; see pixi_add().

renv's .Rprofile line, source("renv/activate.R"), makes R use renv's library, so deactivate = TRUE removes it, like renv::deactivate(). renv.lock and the renv folder stay; delete them when you no longer need them.

Usage

pixi_import_renv(
  lockfile = NULL,
  versions = c("minimum", "exact", "none"),
  all = FALSE,
  deactivate = TRUE,
  path = NULL,
  dry_run = FALSE
)

Arguments

lockfile

Optional. The lock file. Defaults to the project's renv.lock.

versions

How to use the lock file's versions:

  • "minimum": at least that version, e.g. >=1.1.4.

  • "exact": that version, e.g. ==1.1.4, if it's on conda-forge, and at least that version if it isn't.

  • "none": the newest versions.

all

If TRUE, add every package in the lock file, including those that are only there because other packages need them.

deactivate

If TRUE, remove renv's line from the project's .Rprofile.

path

The project. Defaults to the project of the running Pixi environment, or the working directory.

dry_run

If TRUE, show the Pixi command without running it.

Value

A list, invisibly, with the package specs added (packages), the packages built from source (from_source), and the packages left out because rpix can't add them from where they came (not_from_repository) or they weren't found (missing).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
pixi_import_renv()
pixi_import_renv(versions = "exact")
} # }
